Based on the search results from Dell's official website, here are the key Dell 4K monitor announcements for 2026:

## Dell UltraSharp 32 4K QD-OLED Monitor

The Dell UltraSharp 32 4K QD-OLED Monitor is the world's first commercial DisplayHDR True Black 500 QD-OLED monitor with Anti-Glare Low-Reflectance (AGLR) technology. This model (U3226Q) is priced at US$2,599.99 and will be available globally beginning February 24, 2026.

The monitor is specifically engineered for creative professionals in media, entertainment and design, offering unmatched visual brilliance with its QD-OLED infinite contrast and exceptional color precision for color-critical workflows like film and video editing, color grading and product design.

## Other 4K Monitor Options

Dell also offers the Dell UltraSharp 27 4K Thunderbolt Hub Monitor - U2725QE, which received an Expert Reviews Product of the Year Award for 2026.

These announcements were made at CES 2026 and are available on Dell's official website.
